---
title: ""
format:
  docx:
    # Written by run_advice() from templates/advice_template.docx, with the
    # stock code, year, ecoregion, publication date and DOI filled in.
    reference-doc: _reference.docx
    number-sections: false
    fig-width: 6.5
    fig-height: 5
    fig-dpi: 300
crossref:
  fig-title: '**Figure**'
  tbl-title: '**Table**'
  title-delim: '**:**'
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  stock_code: "sol.27.7d"
  assessment_year: 2026
  data_dir: "data"
  historical_from: null        # first assessment year in the historical plots
  historical_first_year: null  # first data year on their x axis
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(icesAdviceSheet)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
})
# Two small internal helpers used in captions and tables below
sag_field <- icesAdviceSheet:::sag_field
advice_category_label <- icesAdviceSheet:::advice_category_label

set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Calibri",
  font.size = 9,
  table.layout = "fixed",
  border.color = "black",
  background.color = "white",
  big.mark = " ",
  decimal.mark = ".",
  padding = 2
)

stock_code <- params$stock_code
assessment_year <- params$assessment_year
advice_year <- assessment_year + 1

x <- readRDS(file.path(params$data_dir, paste0(stock_code, "_", assessment_year, ".rds")))
sag <- x$sag
f <- advice_fields(x)

pending <- function(what) paste0("**[Pending: ", what, "]**")
or_pending <- function(v, what) if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) pending(what) else v

# Short stock name for captions, e.g. "Sole in Division 7.d (eastern English Channel)"
cap_name <- or_pending(f$title_md, "stock description")
status_txt <- status_sentence(sag, f$refpts, assessment_year)
```

## `r cap_name`

# ICES advice on fishing opportunities

`r or_pending(f$advice_sentence, "advice sentence from ASD")`

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (gap in asd_gaps(x$asd_record)) cat(pending(gap), "\n\n")
```

# Stock development over time

`r or_pending(status_txt, "stock status sentence, check reference points")`

```{r}
#| label: fig-summary
#| fig-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Summary of the stock assessment. Catches (landings and discards where available), recruitment, fishing pressure, and spawning-stock biomass, with reference points where defined.")'
#| fig-height: 3.6
plot_stock_summary(
  sag,
  refpts = f$refpts,
  stamp = paste(stock_code, assessment_year, x$assessment_key,
                format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S"), sep = "_")
)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (gap in sag_gaps(sag)) cat(pending(gap), "\n\n")
```

# Catch scenarios

```{r}
#| label: tbl-catchscenarios
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Annual catch scenarios for ", advice_year, ". All weights are in tonnes.")'
asd_scenarios_ft(x$asd_table, x$asd_notes)
```

# Basis of the advice

```{r}
#| label: tbl-advicebasis
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". The basis of the advice.")'
mp_txt <- if (is.na(f$management_plan_link) || !nzchar(f$management_plan_link)) {
  "[To be supplied by the expert group.]"
} else {
  paste0(
    "[To be supplied by the expert group.] ASD: management alignment = ",
    f$management_alignment, "; plan reference: ", f$management_plan_link
  )
}
item_table_ft(data.frame(
  Item = c("Advice basis", "Management plan"),
  Description = c(
    if (is.na(f$advice_category)) "[Pending: ASD advice category]" else advice_category_label(f$advice_category),
    mp_txt
  )
))
```

# Quality of the assessment

[Text to be supplied by the expert group.]

```{r}
#| include: false
hist_data <- x$sag_history$data
hist_notes <- c(
  if (is.null(x$sag_history)) "no historical assessment data; this data file predates them, so re-run get_stock_data()",
  if (!is.null(hist_data) && length(unique(hist_data$AssessmentYear)) < 2) "no earlier advice assessments of this stock were found in SAG for the four previous years",
  x$sag_history$notes
)
show_hist <- !is.null(hist_data) && nrow(hist_data) > 0
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-historical
#| fig-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Historical assessment results (final-year recruitment estimates included).", if (!is.null(params$historical_from)) paste0(" Only assessments from ", params$historical_from, " onwards are shown."))'
#| fig-height: 2.4
#| include: !expr show_hist
plot_historical(hist_data, sag, f$refpts,
                from_assessment = params$historical_from,
                first_year = params$historical_first_year)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (note in hist_notes) cat(pending(note), "\n\n")
```

# Reference points

```{r}
#| label: tbl-refpoints
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Reference points, values, and their technical basis. Weights are in tonnes.")'
refpts_ft(f$refpts)
```

# Basis of the assessment

```{r}
#| label: tbl-assbasis
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Basis of the assessment and advice.")'
item_table_ft(data.frame(
  Item = c(
    "ICES stock data category",
    "Assessment type",
    "Input data",
    "Discards and bycatch",
    "Indicators",
    "Other information",
    "Working group"
  ),
  Description = c(
    if (is.na(f$data_category)) "[Pending: SID data category]" else paste0(f$data_category, "."),
    if (is.na(f$assessment_type)) "[Pending: SID assessment type]" else paste0(f$assessment_type, "."),
    "[To be supplied by the expert group.]",
    "[To be supplied by the expert group.]",
    "None.",
    "[To be supplied by the expert group.]",
    if (is.na(f$expert_group)) "[Pending: SID expert group]" else paste0(f$expert_group, ".")
  )
))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-history
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". ICES advice, agreed TAC, and ICES estimates of catch. All weights are in tonnes.")'
advice_history_ft(x$asd_history, sag)
```

# Summary of the assessment

```{r}
#| label: tbl-assessmentsummary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0(cap_name, ". Assessment summary. Units are given in the column headings. ", if (is.na(sag_field(sag, "ConfidenceIntervalDefinition"))) "High and low are the confidence bounds." else paste0("High and low refer to ", sag_field(sag, "ConfidenceIntervalDefinition"), " confidence intervals."))'
stock_summary_ft(sag)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# "Citation box" style (in the template): boxed, at the bottom of the last page
cat(
  '::: {custom-style="Citation box"}\n',
  paste0(
    "Recommended citation: ICES. ", assessment_year, ". ",
    or_pending(f$title_md, "stock description"), ". ",
    "*In* Report of the ICES Advisory Committee, ", assessment_year, ". ",
    "ICES Advice ", assessment_year, ", ", stock_code, ". ",
    if (is.na(f$doi)) pending("DOI") else paste0("https://doi.org/", f$doi)
  ),
  "\n:::\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
